review_notes: I read the whole file. I also checked the related definitions: `SquareClassGroup` is an abbrev for `Additive Kˣ ⧸ (Subgroup.square Kˣ).toAddSubgroup`, so it is built on Mathlib's `Subgroup.square`. `TauCeti.square_eq_range_powMonoidHom` links `Subgroup.square` to Mathlib's `powMonoidHom` (defined in Mathlib/Algebra/Group/Hom/Basic.lean). The definitions in this file are `localSpinorNorm`, `localSpinorNormImage` and `mem_localSpinorNormImage_iff`. `localSpinorNorm` is `CliffordAlgebra.spinorNorm` composed with `Subgroup.subtype`. `localSpinorNormImage` is `MonoidHom.range` of that. Both are thin, named restrictions of existing concepts, so neither competes with a Mathlib concept. `localSpinorNormImage` is the range of a different map from the ambient spinor norm, so it does not duplicate that either. The openness proof reuses the existing discrete-quotient and square-open lemmas. I found no competing independent concept in the file. I did not search exhaustively for a Mathlib `spinorNorm`, but the file imports and uses a `CliffordAlgebra.spinorNorm` rather than defining its own.
